edits.new:
USE ISO_C_BINDING, ONLY: c_int, c_float
   IMPLICIT NONE

REAL :: scale
   INTEGER(c_int) :: pd_masked_done
   INTEGER, PARAMETER :: pd_masked_kind_guard = 1 / MERGE(1,0,KIND(0.)==c_float .AND. STORAGE_SIZE(0.)==32 .AND. KIND(0)==c_int)
   INTERFACE
     INTEGER(c_int) FUNCTION pd_masked_scale8(n,flux,phlow,epsilon,out) BIND(C)
       IMPORT c_int, c_float
       INTEGER(c_int), VALUE :: n
       REAL(c_float), INTENT(IN) :: flux(*), phlow(*)
       REAL(c_float), VALUE :: epsilon
       REAL(c_float), INTENT(INOUT) :: out(*)
     END FUNCTION pd_masked_scale8
   END INTERFACE

edits.old:
DO i=i_start, i_end
     pd_scale(i,k,j) = -1.
     IF( flux_out_row(i) .gt. ph_low_row(i) ) THEN
       scale = max(0.,ph_low_row(i)/(flux_out_row(i)+eps))
       pd_scale(i,k,j) = scale
     END IF
   ENDDO
edits.new:
pd_masked_done = 0
   IF (i_start <= i_end) THEN
     pd_masked_done = pd_masked_scale8(i_end-i_start+1,flux_out_row(i_start),ph_low_row(i_start),eps,pd_scale(i_start,k,j))
   END IF
   DO i=i_start+pd_masked_done, i_end
     pd_scale(i,k,j) = -1.
     IF( flux_out_row(i) .gt. ph_low_row(i) ) THEN
       scale = max(0.,ph_low_row(i)/(flux_out_row(i)+eps))
       pd_scale(i,k,j) = scale
     END IF
   ENDDO
